name: Black Forest Smoothie

ingredients.name: peeled frozen ripe banana, cut into 4 pieces
cacao nibs, plus more for serving

instructions.primary_message: In a blender, combine frozen cherries, banana, spinach (if using), milk, cocoa powder, cacao nibs, and salt. Pulse a few times to break the banana, then blend on high speed until smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down sides as needed, 1 to 2 minutes. Divide evenly between 2 glasses. Top with extra cacao nibs and fresh cherries, if desired. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: chocolate smoothie, smoothie, breakfast smoothie, banana smoothie, cherry smoothie, cherry chocolate smoothie, banana chocolate smoothie

description: This black forest smoothie combines sweet cherries, cocoa, cacao nibs, and banana into a cold, creamy breakfast smoothie inspired by black forest cake.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 2 cups baby spinach (2 ounces; 57 g), optional; Fresh cherries, for serving, optional

Optional substitutions: unsweetened almond milk → your preferred milk

Notes: While we prefer almond milk here for its mild, slightly nutty flavor, any milk will work well in its place, including oat, soy, coconut, or dairy milk.

Make-ahead and storage: Iced drinks are best enjoyed immediately after blending.
author: Laila Ibrahim
